annotations.description: Llama4 Rookie timed out and failed to play a land on turn 3. They had two Mountains and a Thriving Bluff in hand. Playing a Mountain would give them 2 mana next turn (one untapped Mountain + Thriving Bluff already in play), enabling a turn 3 Chandra's Magmutt. Missing a land drop in the early game slows development significantly.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed without playing a land.
annotations.betterLine: Play a Mountain to have 2 mana available next turn for Chandra's Magmutt, maintaining curve development.

annotations.description: Player timed out and failed to play a land or cast a 1-mana spell on turn 4. They had Island in hand and 1 land drop remaining, plus could cast Chromatic Sphere or Lightning-Core Excavator. Missing a land drop on turn 4 when you have expensive cards like Hedron Archive (4), Rapacious Dragon-type plays, and Meteor Golem (7) in hand is a real setback to the curve. At minimum, playing the Island would have given 2 mana next turn to start casting spells.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out (no response), passing priority without playing a land or casting anything.
annotations.betterLine: Play Island, then cast Chromatic Sphere (or Lightning-Core Excavator) with the available mana. This develops the board and sets up for Hedron Archive on turn 5 with 3 lands.

annotations.description: Llama4 Rookie timed out and failed to play a land or cast Chandra's Magmutt on turn 5. They had a Mountain in hand and exactly enough mana (2 lands + the new Mountain = 3 mana sources next turn) to develop their board. Playing Mountain and casting Chandra's Magmutt ({1}{R}) was the clear line, putting a 2/2 on board that can also ping. Instead, nothing happened — no land drop, no spell cast. This sets them back a full turn of development.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out / no response — passed without playing a land or casting any spell.
annotations.betterLine: Play Mountain, then cast Chandra's Magmutt for {1}{R} using the two Thriving Bluffs and/or the new Mountain. This develops the board and starts the clock toward casting bigger threats like Rapacious Dragon on curve.

annotations.description: Timed out and failed to cast Aether Spellbomb when it was the only available play. With 2 untapped lands and no other castable spells this turn, deploying the 1-mana artifact would have been free in terms of opportunity cost and provides future utility (creature bounce for {U} or card draw for {1}). It also synergizes with Archaeomender in hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed without casting anything, wasting 1+ mana this turn.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Aether Spellbomb for {1} to deploy it on board for future use.

annotations.description: Player is severely mana-screwed (only 2 lands on turn 8) with an expensive hand (Hedron Archive, Meteor Golem, Crypt Lurker, Gristle Grinner). The only available action was to activate Aether Spellbomb, which could be sacrificed for {1} to draw a card and dig for lands, or for {U} to bounce the opponent's Dragonloft Idol. Drawing to find lands is critical when this far behind on mana development.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Aether Spellbomb, ending the turn.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Aether Spellbomb by paying {1} and sacrificing it to draw a card, trying to find a land drop for next turn. Being stuck on 2 lands with a hand full of 4-7 mana cards means every draw counts.

annotations.description: Failed to activate Chandra's Magmutt's tap ability to deal 1 damage to the opponent before combat. The Magmutt would be better used for its ping ability than attacking into a 0/3 blocker, so this is a free point of damage wasted.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed without activating Chandra's Magmutt
annotations.betterLine: Activate Chandra's Magmutt to deal 1 damage to the opponent, then proceed to combat with the flying creatures.

annotations.description: Lightning-Core Excavator (0/3) could have blocked Chandra's Magmutt (2/2) for free — the Excavator survives the block (takes 2 damage, has 3 toughness) and saves 2 life. With opponent having zero untapped mana, there's no risk of a combat trick. Taking 9 damage instead of 7 against a board that includes an incoming Hellkite Punisher is unnecessarily costly.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 9 damage (2 + 4 + 3) from all three attackers.
annotations.betterLine: Block Chandra's Magmutt with Lightning-Core Excavator to save 2 life while the Excavator survives the block.

annotations.description: Pumping Hellkite Punisher in precombat main phase when opponent has Aether Spellbomb available (with blue mana from Thriving Isle). If the opponent bounces Hellkite in response to attacks or during combat, the R spent on pump is wasted. Should pump during combat after seeing if opponent uses the Spellbomb.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Hellkite Punisher's +1/+0 ability during precombat main phase
annotations.betterLine: Move to combat, declare attackers with all available creatures (Hellkite, Rapacious Dragon, Dragonloft Idol, Chandra's Magmutt), then pump Hellkite during combat after seeing if opponent uses Aether Spellbomb to bounce it

annotations.description: Facing 16 damage (lethal at 11 life), the player timed out and assigned no blockers and didn't activate Aether Spellbomb. They had Thriving Isle untapped to pay {U} to bounce Hellkite Punisher (7/6 flyer) with Aether Spellbomb, and could block Chandra's Magmutt with Lightning-Core Excavator, reducing incoming damage to 7 and surviving at 4 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out with no response — no blockers assigned, no Aether Spellbomb activation, taking 16 lethal damage.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Aether Spellbomb (pay {U} from Thriving Isle) to bounce Hellkite Punisher, then block Chandra's Magmutt with Lightning-Core Excavator. Incoming damage becomes 4 (Dragonloft Idol) + 3 (Rapacious Dragon) = 7, surviving at 4 life.

annotations.description: Gem31P Analyst is at 11 life facing 16+ damage from attackers (Chandra's Magmutt 2, Dragonloft Idol 4, Hellkite Punisher 7, Rapacious Dragon 3). By passing without blocking or using Aether Spellbomb, they take lethal damage. They had the mana to activate Aether Spellbomb (costs {U}) to bounce Hellkite Punisher (removing 7 damage) and could block Chandra's Magmutt with Lightning-Core Excavator (removing 2 more damage), reducing incoming damage to just 7 and surviving at 4 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without declaring any blockers or activating Aether Spellbomb, taking 16+ lethal damage.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Aether Spellbomb targeting Hellkite Punisher to bounce it, and block Chandra's Magmutt with Lightning-Core Excavator. This reduces incoming damage to 7 (Dragonloft Idol 4 + Rapacious Dragon 3), surviving at 4 life.

annotations.description: Dragon Hatchling is summoning sick and not attacking, so pumping it with R does absolutely nothing. That mana should have been spent pumping Hellkite Punisher (which IS attacking) to increase combat damage by 1. With opponent at 11 life facing 16+ damage, every point matters — especially if the opponent has Aether Spellbomb to bounce a creature, making the margin tighter.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Dragon Hatchling's pump ability (+1/+0) even though Dragon Hatchling is not attacking and is summoning sick.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Hellkite Punisher's pump ability with the Mountain instead, making it 8/6 and increasing total combat damage to 17. This maximizes pressure and makes it harder for the opponent to survive even with Aether Spellbomb bounce.
